purpose: At every frozen answer boundary, factor the native reader update into answer-boundary versus non-boundary and current-query versus prior-history positions, then use a separately marked label-aware local-gradient oracle to distinguish position cancellation from answer-axis misalignment.

position_contract.answer_boundary_only: Apply the reader update only to the final token at the current Answer: boundary.
position_contract.non_boundary_only: Apply the reader update to every valid query position except the final answer-boundary token.
position_contract.current_query_only: At h0 use the complete initial prompt. At h1-h4 use only the frozen repeated query suffix after the most recent forced original-answer token, including the final answer boundary.
position_contract.prior_history_only: Apply the update only before the current-query span; this is an exact zero lane at h0.
position_contract.full_route: Replay the complete one-step reader update over all valid positions.
position_contract.disjoint_reconstruction: In native BF16 input space, boundary plus non-boundary and current-query plus prior-history must each reconstruct the full replay exactly.

oracle_contract.basis: The full-sequence local gradient of the affected donor-minus-original margin or unaffected original-minus-alternative margin through native layers 16-31.
oracle_contract.projection: Globally project each intact or twin update onto the flattened local-gradient direction; the paired orthogonal residual is also decoded.

measurements.1_native_position_ablation: Compare signed intact/twin effects for full, boundary, non-boundary, current-query, and prior-history native BF16 replays.
measurements.2_local_linear_attribution: At all five horizons, record the full-sequence answer-gradient projection for requested and actual native updates in every lane.
measurements.3_label_aware_oracle: Decode the global answer-axis projection and its orthogonal residual as diagnostic ceilings only; they cannot select a deployable route.
measurements.4_specificity: Retain learned, positionwise full-Gram random, unrelated-world same-query, and sham pairs for affected and unaffected cases.
measurements.5_predecessor_replication: The learned full-route and answer-boundary effects and base readout must exactly reproduce the frozen recurrence report before new interpretation.

predeclared_focus.reason: The predecessor showed donor-directed boundary-only and reversed full-route effects in this cell.

stop_rule: Execute every frozen cell once. Preserve failures. Do not select a layer, case, horizon, control, threshold, position mask, or oracle lane after target-model scoring.
claim_boundary: This fixed-token assay can locate how complete reader updates at layer 16 are mediated by answer-boundary, non-boundary, current-query, and prior-history positions for eight frozen Mistral cases and two existing checkpoints. The label-aware local-gradient projection is an oracle diagnostic, not a deployable architecture candidate. The assay does not train a position gate, validate free generation, establish semantic memory, generalization, capability, K/V accumulation, portability, or speed. It cannot rescue the failed grouped F1-F5 gates; the scientific winner remains none.
